plan.title: Self-Directed Curriculum Foundation and Module 1 Pilot

narratives.Description: Establish the approved curriculum foundation and deliver a fully self-directed Module 1 pilot. This is the only scope approved for activation and implementation in the first milestone.
narratives.UserStory: As a 3Ci engineer new to Directive, I want a trustworthy starting point and a complete first module, so that I can begin learning independently and verify my understanding without undocumented help.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
1. Record the approved project definition and version-aware source baseline.
2. Build learner navigation, reusable content templates, Module 1, its exercise and solution, initial references, the disposable-lab model, and the maintenance contract.
3. Verify every Directive claim and command against the pinned consumer release, then run the literal quality checks.
narratives.Acceptance:
AC-01: PROJECT-DEFINITION.xbrief.json records the approved private 3Ci identity, self-directed delivery model, learner profile, goals, source-of-truth boundaries, safety constraints, portability target, and unresolved named-owner/pilot decisions.
AC-02: references/SOURCE-BASELINE.md records the exact package and engine pins, official tag and commit when resolvable, verification date, source headings, tested help surfaces, adaptation method, and disagreements.
AC-03: README.md gives an independent learner an exact start and recovery path, while curriculum/README.md maps all eleven core modules and future electives with prerequisites, timing, and navigation.
AC-04: Reusable module, lab, assessment, and solution templates contain the complete self-directed contracts and no empty placeholders are presented as completed content.
AC-05: Module 1 is learner-ready and contains observable outcomes, a starting-state check, mental model, guided teaching, a fictional classification exercise, progressive hints, expected failures and recovery, common misconceptions, self-assessment, completion evidence, an explained solution, navigation, and official references.
AC-06: The initial glossary, quick reference, disposable-lab model, and curriculum-maintenance note distinguish current xBRIEF 0.8 guidance, 3Ci policy, upstream behavior, and future internal publishing projections.
AC-07: Session/runtime state and framework deposits remain untracked; the content contains no client or confidential data and requires no instructor explanation.
AC-08: npm run check:cold-start-readme, directive verify:vbrief-conformance --project-root ., and task deft:check pass on the feature branch.
AC-09: No content is pushed, opened as a pull request, merged, published, released, or deployed.

items.title: Record project identity and Directive source baseline

narrative.Acceptance: The approved xBRIEF 0.8 project definition is authoritative, and the source manifest makes every major version-sensitive claim traceable to the pinned released package and tested CLI surface.

items.title: Create learner navigation and reusable self-directed templates

narrative.Acceptance: A learner can identify where to start, what the full core path contains, how long it takes, how to resume, and how each future module, lab, assessment, and solution must be authored.

items.title: Author the complete What Directive Is module and solution set

narrative.Acceptance: Module 1 satisfies every required self-directed section and lets a learner classify realistic tools and scenarios, compare against an explained answer, recover from mistakes, and prove the stated outcomes without an instructor.

items.title: Document reference aids, disposable lab safety, and maintenance

narrative.Acceptance: The glossary, quick reference, lab model, and maintenance note are substantive, current-version aware, fictional and non-sensitive, explicit about 3Ci overlays, and portable to a later governed internal-publishing projection.

items.title: Run and record milestone quality evidence

narrative.Acceptance: The literal approved checks pass from the feature branch, generated or runtime state is not committed, and the milestone remains local with no unauthorized remote or publishing action.
